# Zedgehost Pakistan

> Affordable web hosting, domain registration, VPS, cloud hosting, and business email services in Pakistan for businesses, startups, and growing brands.

Zedgehost Pakistan helps individuals, startups, agencies, and businesses launch and manage reliable websites in Pakistan. We provide shared hosting, WordPress hosting, cloud hosting, VPS, reseller hosting, Windows hosting, business email, website security, domain registration, SSL certificates, and website migration support.

Our content is designed to help Pakistani customers compare hosting plans, choose the right domain, understand hosting performance, and purchase services with confidence. We publish practical guidance around website growth, hosting requirements, domain strategy, and business-ready web services.

## Core hosting solutions

- [Web Hosting in Pakistan](https://www.zedgehost.com/): Affordable hosting for businesses, startups, and personal websites with domain and support services.
- [Shared Hosting in Pakistan](https://www.zedgehost.com/shared-hosting.html): SSD-based shared hosting for small businesses and growing websites.
- [WordPress Hosting in Pakistan](https://www.zedgehost.com/wordpress-hosting.html): Managed WordPress hosting with speed, security, and simplified setup.
- [Cloud Hosting in Pakistan](https://www.zedgehost.com/cloud-hosting.html): Scalable hosting for busy sites and business workloads.
- [Linux VPS Hosting in Pakistan](https://www.zedgehost.com/linux-vps-server.html): Flexible VPS hosting with root access and dedicated resources.
- [Windows Hosting in Pakistan](https://www.zedgehost.com/windows-shared-hosting.html): ASP.NET and Windows-compatible hosting for business applications.
- [Reseller Hosting in Pakistan](https://www.zedgehost.com/reseller-hosting.html): White-label hosting packages for agencies and entrepreneurs.
